page_metadata.meta_description:
**Strategy_500 – Turtle Soup NY M5 Sweep**

This strategy is based on a New York session liquidity model using a predefined 3-hour range.

The first step is to build the range between **06:00 and 08:59 New York time**. Once that range is completed, the strategy waits for price to take liquidity above or below the range during the active trading window, from **09:00 to 12:00 New York time**.

The logic is simple:

Price must first sweep one side of the 3-hour range.

pine_source_verbatim:
//@version=6
strategy(
     "Strategy_500 - Turtle Soup NY V5 M5 Sweep",
     overlay = true,
     pyramiding = 0,
     initial_capital = 10000,
     process_orders_on_close = true
)

//====================================================
//==================== INPUTS ========================
//====================================================

// HORARIO RANGO
rangeSession = input.session(
     "0600-0859",
     "Rango NY",
     group = "Horario"
)

// HORARIO OPERATIVA
startHour = input.int(
     9,
     "Hora inicio",
     minval = 0,
     maxval = 23,
     group = "Horario"
)

startMinute = input.int(
     0,
     "Minuto inicio",
     minval = 0,
     maxval = 59,
     group = "Horario"
)

endHour = input.int(
     12,
     "Hora fin",
     minval = 0,
     maxval = 23,
     group = "Horario"
)

endMinute = input.int(
     0,
     "Minuto fin",
     minval = 0,
     maxval = 59,
     group = "Horario"
)

// GESTIÓN
slBuffer = input.float(
     2.0,
     "SL Buffer",
     step = 0.25,
     group = "Gestión"
)

minimumRR = input.float(
     1.0,
     "RR mínimo",
     step = 0.1,
     group = "Gestión"
)

// VISUAL
showBox = input.bool(
     true,
     "Mostrar caja",
     group = "Visual"
)

showLabels = input.bool(
     true,
     "Mostrar etiquetas",
     group = "Visual"
)

//====================================================
//==================== HORARIO =======================
//====================================================

nyHour = hour(time, "America/New_York")
nyMinute = minute(time, "America/New_York")

afterStart = (
     nyHour > startHour or
     (nyHour == startHour and nyMinute >= startMinute)
)

beforeEnd = (
     nyHour < endHour or
     (nyHour == endHour and nyMinute <= endMinute)
)

allowedTrading = afterStart and beforeEnd

//====================================================
//==================== RESET =========================
//====================================================

newDay = dayofmonth(time, "America/New_York") != dayofmonth(time[1], "America/New_York")

var bool tradeTaken = false

if newDay
    tradeTaken := false

//====================================================
//==================== RANGO 3H ======================
//====================================================

inRange = not na(
     time(
          timeframe.period,
          rangeSession,
          "America/New_York"
     )
)

var float rangeHigh = na
var float rangeLow = na

var bool rangeReady = false

newRange = inRange and not inRange[1]
endRange = not inRange and inRange[1]

// RESET
if newDay
    rangeHigh := na
    rangeLow := na
    rangeReady := false

// INICIO
if newRange
    rangeHigh := high
    rangeLow := low

// CONSTRUCCIÓN
if inRange
    rangeHigh := math.max(rangeHigh, high)
    rangeLow := math.min(rangeLow, low)

// FINAL
if endRange
    rangeReady := true

//====================================================
//==================== VISUALES ======================
//====================================================

var box rangeBox = na

if showBox

    if newRange

        rangeBox := box.new(
             left = bar_index,
             right = bar_index,
             top = high,
             bottom = low,
             bgcolor = color.new(color.purple, 88),
             border_color = color.new(color.gray, 50)
        )

    if inRange and not na(rangeBox)

        box.set_top(rangeBox, rangeHigh)
        box.set_bottom(rangeBox, rangeLow)
        box.set_right(rangeBox, bar_index)

// HIGH
plot(
     rangeReady ? rangeHigh : na,
     color = color.red,
     linewidth = 3,
     title = "HIGH RANGO"
)

// LOW
plot(
     rangeReady ? rangeLow : na,
     color = color.aqua,
     linewidth = 3,
     title = "LOW RANGO"
)

//====================================================
//=========== TOMA LIQUIDEZ RANGO 3H =================
//====================================================

// BARRIDA LOW DEL RANGO 3H
sweepRangeLow = (
     rangeReady and
     low < rangeLow
)

// BARRIDA HIGH DEL RANGO 3H
sweepRangeHigh = (
     rangeReady and
     high > rangeHigh
)

//====================================================
//============ TURTLE SOUP / SWEEP M5 ================
//====================================================

// LONG:
// La vela actual barre el mínimo de la vela anterior,
// recupera cerrando por encima del mínimo anterior,
// y además cierra verde.
bullishM5TurtleSoup = (
     low < low[1] and
     close > low[1] and
     close > open
)

// SHORT:
// La vela actual barre el máximo de la vela anterior,
// recupera cerrando por debajo del máximo anterior,
// y además cierra roja.
bearishM5TurtleSoup = (
     high > high[1] and
     close < high[1] and
     close < open
)

//====================================================
//==================== VARIABLES =====================
//====================================================

var bool longSetup = false
var bool shortSetup = false

var int longSetupBar = na
var int shortSetupBar = na

var float longManipulationLow = na
var float shortManipulationHigh = na

//====================================================
//==================== DETECCIÓN =====================
//====================================================

// LONG SETUP:
// Primero se toma la liquidez del LOW del rango 3H.
if rangeReady and allowedTrading and not tradeTaken

    if sweepRangeLow

        if not longSetup
            longSetupBar := bar_index

        longSetup := true
        shortSetup := false

        longManipulationLow := na(longManipulationLow) ? low : math.min(longManipulationLow, low)

        shortManipulationHigh := na
        shortSetupBar := na

// SHORT SETUP:
// Primero se toma la liquidez del HIGH del rango 3H.
if rangeReady and allowedTrading and not tradeTaken

    if sweepRangeHigh

        if not shortSetup
            shortSetupBar := bar_index

        shortSetup := true
        longSetup := false

        shortManipulationHigh := na(shortManipulationHigh) ? high : math.max(shortManipulationHigh, high)

        longManipulationLow := na
        longSetupBar := na

//====================================================
//==================== LONG ==========================
//====================================================

bool longSignal = false

float longSL = na
float longTP = na
float longEntry = na

if (
     longSetup and
     allowedTrading and
     not tradeTaken and
     strategy.position_size == 0 and
     bar_index > longSetupBar and
     bullishM5TurtleSoup
)

    tempSL = math.min(longManipulationLow, low) - slBuffer
    tempEntry = close
    tempTP = rangeHigh

    risk = tempEntry - tempSL
    reward = tempTP - tempEntry

    rr = reward / risk

    if risk > 0 and reward > 0 and rr >= minimumRR

        longSignal := true

        longSL := tempSL
        longEntry := tempEntry
        longTP := tempTP

//====================================================
//==================== SHORT =========================
//====================================================

bool shortSignal = false

float shortSL = na
float shortTP = na
float shortEntry = na

if (
     shortSetup and
     allowedTrading and
     not tradeTaken and
     strategy.position_size == 0 and
     bar_index > shortSetupBar and
     bearishM5TurtleSoup
)

    tempSL = math.max(shortManipulationHigh, high) + slBuffer
    tempEntry = close
    tempTP = rangeLow

    risk = tempSL - tempEntry
    reward = tempEntry - tempTP

    rr = reward / risk

    if risk > 0 and reward > 0 and rr >= minimumRR

        shortSignal := true

        shortSL := tempSL
        shortEntry := tempEntry
        shortTP := tempTP

//====================================================
//==================== ENTRADAS ======================
//====================================================

// LONG
if longSignal and strategy.position_size == 0 and not tradeTaken

    strategy.entry(
         "LONG",
         strategy.long
    )

    strategy.exit(
         "LONG EXIT",
         from_entry = "LONG",
         stop = longSL,
         limit = longTP
    )

    tradeTaken := true

    longSetup := false
    longSetupBar := na
    longManipulationLow := na

    // ENTRY
    line.new(
         bar_index,
         longEntry,
         bar_index + 20,
         longEntry,
         color = color.yellow,
         width = 2
    )

    // SL
    line.new(
         bar_index,
         longSL,
         bar_index + 20,
         longSL,
         color = color.red,
         width = 2
    )

    // TP
    line.new(
         bar_index,
         longTP,
         bar_index + 20,
         longTP,
         color = color.aqua,
         width = 2
    )

    if showLabels

        label.new(
             bar_index,
             low,
             "LONG M5 TS",
             style = label.style_label_up,
             color = color.lime,
             textcolor = color.black
        )

// SHORT
if shortSignal and strategy.position_size == 0 and not tradeTaken

    strategy.entry(
         "SHORT",
         strategy.short
    )

    strategy.exit(
         "SHORT EXIT",
         from_entry = "SHORT",
         stop = shortSL,
         limit = shortTP
    )

    tradeTaken := true

    shortSetup := false
    shortSetupBar := na
    shortManipulationHigh := na

    // ENTRY
    line.new(
         bar_index,
         shortEntry,
         bar_index + 20,
         shortEntry,
         color = color.yellow,
         width = 2
    )

    // SL
    line.new(
         bar_index,
         shortSL,
         bar_index + 20,
         shortSL,
         color = color.red,
         width = 2
    )

    // TP
    line.new(
         bar_index,
         shortTP,
         bar_index + 20,
         shortTP,
         color = color.aqua,
         width = 2
    )

    if showLabels

        label.new(
             bar_index,
             high,
             "SHORT M5 TS",
             style = label.style_label_down,
             color = color.red,
             textcolor = color.white
        )

//====================================================
//==================== ALERTAS =======================
//====================================================

alertcondition(
     longSignal,
     title = "LONG",
     message = "LONG M5 Turtle Soup después de barrida del rango 3H"
)

alertcondition(
     shortSignal,
     title = "SHORT",
     message = "SHORT M5 Turtle Soup después de barrida del rango 3H"
)
